name: Cook Mode
shortDescription: Your recipes, one giant step at a time, with timers in the text.
description:
Your own recipes as a site with a cook mode for the stove. Cook mode shows one step per screen in 36-pixel type, with the ingredients that step needs pinned in a strip below it and a row of dots for where you are. Every time written in a step, like "10 minutes" or "2½ hours", is a chip you tap to start a timer. The chip turns into a pill that drains as the time runs down and plays a two-tone chime at zero, even if the phone was locked in between. Steps turn with a swipe or the arrow keys, and the screen stays awake while you cook.

The servings slider rescales every quantity live, in metric or US measures, with real fractions like ½, ⅓, and ¾. The index is a wall of recipe cards with a cuisine-colored edge and the total time as a small clock arc, under a live "Tonight" card for the recipe you pinned. Mark recipes for this week and the shopping page adds up everything they need into one list.

You never fill in a form: send your agent a link, a photo of a recipe card, or a description, and it writes the recipe into your book and rebuilds the site.
